physical: Phase transition and critical point — At a continuous phase transition the order parameter vanishes and the correlation length diverges: fluctuations at every scale, and no characteristic size. ξ → ∞ as T → T_c. Form: limit.
reflected_sentence: The relation keeps its shape: a measure of order falls to nothing while an extent of mutual influence grows without end — said in plain words only, since neither has a partner and no resistance caused the limit.
rule_reason: no variable carries resistance (order parameter, correlation length and temperature are all fixed as non-resistance) and no cost or separation is listed; the divergence of an extent is not a cost caused by resistance, so the even (zero) count keeps the shape
interpretation: Nothing crosses. The shape keeps in silence.
closing: The rule decided alone: no resistance-carrier among the variables and no listed cost, so the count is even and the relation keeps. The English echo of 'limitless' in a divergence was tempting, but the vocabulary supplies no partner for any term here, so there was nothing to hang a reflection on, and I refused to supply one.
